A '''chokladboll''' (literally meaning ''chocolate ball'') is a traditional [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Sweden|Swedish]] pastry often eaten with [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]] during [[w:Fika_(coffee_break)|fika]]. They are quick and easy to prepare, since they require no baking and only a few, common ingredients.

== Ingredients ==
* 3 ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 1.1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) [[Cookbook:Oats|quick oats]]
* 1 ¼ cups (275 g / 9.7 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tbsp|Tbsp]] (75 g / 2.6 oz) [[Cookbook:Cocoa|cocoa]]
* 1 Tbsp (15 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 14 g / 0.49 oz) [[Cookbook:Vanilla Sugar|vanilla sugar]] OR 1 tsp (5 ml / 0.17 oz) [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract, added with the coffee
* ⅔ cup (160 g / 5.6 oz) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]], softened
* 6 Tbsp (90 ml / 3 oz) cold [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]]
* Flaked [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]] or [[Cookbook:Pearl Sugar|pearl sugar]]

== Procedure ==
# Mix oats, sugar, vanilla sugar, and cocoa in a large bowl.
# Using your hands or a [[Cookbook:Potato Masher|potato masher]], incorporate the butter into the dry ingredients until the dough has an even consistency.
# Add the coffee and mix until incorporated.
# Fill a small bowl with flaked coconut or pearl sugar.
# With your hands, roll the dough into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (3 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) diameter balls.
# Roll each ball in the coconut or pearl sugar and place on a tray.
# Chill chocolate balls for at least one hour before serving.
